alignment.alignment_rule: Configured scene spawn and first pre-action body odometry only. No fitting to trajectory or future evaluation poses. First truth observation is diagnostic only.

fixed_before_scoring.scope: Offline sensitivity; original poses, beams, parameters, native field and world grid unchanged

interpretation_limits: Configured spawn anchors global SE2; early LIO pose noise and actual settled body yaw deviation remain in the reported residual
Odometry is the existing Point-LIO plus original loam/sensor_scan body transform output; raw IMU-filter state was not recorded
Single-scan score surfaces do not reproduce AMCL particle priors/resampling
No diagnostic poses or transforms are sent to a running localization node
